body:
A developer who clones a Solace project gets a working copy of it: its projects, code store, strategy and tasks. Solace explains plainly when something can't be set up.

**In scope:** committing tasks without their conversations or run details; clear messages when a clone has nothing to migrate, is missing a project's store, or sits inside another workspace.

**Out of scope for now:** blocking a task from being started on two computers; merging two people's edits to one task; merging code stores (feature:08df236ce13570c0).
title: Share a project with teammates
